description: Java class 'ShippingEvents' providing methods for calculating shipping estimates, handling shipping addresses, and retrieving shipment time estimates within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ShippingEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for shipping fee calculations, address retrieval, and shipment time estimation within OFBiz.

methods.name: getShipEstimate
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimates for all shipping groups in the shopping cart and applies promotions.

methods.name: getShipGroupEstimate
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimate for a specific shipping group or order item, considering shipping method, address, and other parameters.

methods.name: getShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Retrieves shipment time estimates based on shipping method, party, role, and addresses.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimate
methods.description: Finds the matching shipment time estimate for a given carrier shipment method.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimateInDay
methods.description: Returns the estimated number of days for shipping based on shipment time estimates.

methods.name: getShippingOriginContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping origin address for a supplier, or general location if specific is unavailable.

methods.name: getShippingOriginContactMechFromFacility
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping origin address from a facility.

methods.name: getGeoIdFromPostalContactMech
methods.description: Extracts geographic IDs from a postal address.

methods.name: getShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Overloaded method to get shipment time estimates based on address objects.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimate
methods.description: Returns the shipment time estimate matching a carrier's shipment method.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimateInDay
methods.description: Calculates the number of days for shipping based on shipment time estimates.

methods.name: getShipmentCustomMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the custom shipping method service name by ID.

methods.name: getExternalShipEstimate
methods.description: Invokes external shipping estimate services, handling custom methods and configurations.
